name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_process_node_polygon_set_xy
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::ProcessNodePolygonSetXY gates clip-patch node processing by clip polygon, node, model pointer, bounds flags, and node processing flags.
known_limits: The smoke target covers null/no-model gates and the 0x20000 IsFullyInsideClipPolygonXY dispatch; 0x10000 clipping output dispatch is covered through the accepted ProcessClipPatchNode target and deferred to the coherent clip-patch cluster pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry model/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46b550 validates null clip/node return, model pointer lookup from node user data, no-model return, optional bounds cull for flag 0x200, flag 0x20000 path that clears outDi and calls IsFullyInsideClipPolygonXY, flag 0x10000 path that calls ProcessClipPatchNode, and default success return.
The native process-node-polygon-set smoke verifies null/no-model gates and the 0x20000 path clearing outDi while returning the accepted IsFullyInsideClipPolygonXY result.
